name: Warehouse — First Delivery
tagline: Turn a route into a completed delivery.
narrative:
The practice warehouse has one package and one outbound station. The robot already follows the aisle route, but movement alone does not complete warehouse work.

Teach the robot to recognise the two work moments: pick up a package when it is on the same tile, and deliver it when it is carrying the package at Outbound A.
objective: Pick up the waiting package and deliver it to Outbound A.
learningObjective: Use world facts to choose interaction actions, not just movement actions.
intelligenceExplanation:
The starting brain already knows how to travel through the fixed aisle. It does not yet know when to pick up or deliver.

Add the work rules before the navigation rules. The warehouse completes as soon as the order is delivered; it does not use the maze's three-tick goal hold.
hint: Add `packageHere → pick-up` and `deliveryHere && carryingPackage → deliver`. Put both above navigation.
hints: The route is present already. Watch the debug panel for Package here and Delivery here.
A package needs an interaction rule, not another move rule: WHEN packageHere → DO pick-up.
Delivery must only happen while carrying cargo: WHEN deliveryHere AND carryingPackage → DO deliver. Keep both work rules above the clear-aisle movement rule.
brief: Teach the robot to pick up the waiting order and drop it at Outbound A.
context: One order, one outbound dock. The robot already drives the aisle — it just doesn't do warehouse work yet.
